welcome.subject: Welcome to Chrlit — your account is active
welcome.body: your account is confirmed and ready. Chrlit learns your brand and churns out finished posts for you — enter your website, go through a short setup and start the first generation.

common.replyHint: If anything gets stuck, just reply to this e-mail.

plans.creditLine: {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} a month — {example}

welcome.preheader: Enter your website and Chrlit will learn your brand.
welcome.intro: Your account is ready. One thing remains — show Chrlit what your brand looks like.
welcome.step2: Chrlit pulls the tone, colours and products from it.
welcome.step3: Generate your first posts — three are free.

receipt.subject: Payment received — {planName}
receipt.heading: Payment successful
receipt.intro: Thank you. We have received **{price}** for **{planName}**. Everything is active.
receipt.invoiceNote: The tax invoice will arrive separately within a few minutes.

client_handoff.subject: {brandName} is waiting for you in Chrlit
client_handoff.preheader: Creating an account takes a minute — the brand is already set up.
client_handoff.heading: {brandName} is ready
client_handoff.intro: We have set up the brand **{brandName}** for you — tone, topics and visuals. One thing remains: create the account it will belong to.
client_handoff.cta: Create an account and take over the brand
client_handoff.afterLoginHeading: What you will see after signing in
client_handoff.afterLogin1: The finished brand configuration — nothing to set up again.
client_handoff.afterLogin2: A post plan and the first generated samples.
client_handoff.afterLogin3: A calendar where you can move dates around as you need.
client_handoff.sameEmail: Create the account with **this** e-mail address — the brand is matched by e-mail.
client_handoff.codeNote: The link above fills it in for you. This is just in case you open the registration by hand.

client_handoff_done.subject: {brandName} is in your account
client_handoff_done.preheader: You will find it in the project switcher right after signing in.
client_handoff_done.heading: {brandName} is yours
client_handoff_done.intro: The brand **{brandName}** is now in your account — you will find it in the project switcher right after signing in. The configuration and generated content stay in place; nothing needs setting up again.

subscription_renewal.subject: Your {planName} subscription renews on {renewsOn}
subscription_renewal.heading: Subscription renewal
subscription_renewal.intro: Your **{planName}** subscription renews automatically on **{renewsOn}** and we will charge **{price}**{term, plural, =1 {} other { for # months}}. Nothing to do on your side.
subscription_renewal.cancelHint: If you don't want to continue, cancel the renewal in the studio — everything keeps working until the renewal date.

subscription_charge_failed.subject: We couldn't charge your payment
subscription_charge_failed.heading: Payment failed
subscription_charge_failed.intro: We couldn't charge **{price}** for the **{planName}** plan (attempt {attempt} of {maxAttempts}).
subscription_charge_failed.reason3: The bank blocked a recurring payment

subscription_expired.subject: Your subscription has ended
subscription_expired.preheader: Your data stays saved; generation is paused.
subscription_expired.heading: Subscription ended
subscription_expired.intro: Your **{planName}** subscription has run out. Generation is paused, but **we haven't deleted anything** — your posts, brand and settings are waiting for you.
subscription_expired.renew: You can renew any time for **{price}** and pick up exactly where generation stopped.

subscription_winback.preheader: We have an offer to bring you back.
subscription_winback.price: The regular plan price is **{price}**. Cancel any time.

waitlist_welcome.preheader: You're on the list. We'll be in touch as soon as spots open up.
waitlist_welcome.next1: We'll e-mail you an access code.
waitlist_welcome.next2: You enter your website and Chrlit learns your brand.
waitlist_welcome.next3: Your first three posts are free — no credit card.

waitlist_invite.introWaited: You've been on our list for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and now it's your turn. A spot has opened up — the code below unlocks your access.
waitlist_invite.intro: A spot has opened up. The code below unlocks your access to Chrlit.
waitlist_invite.codeHint: Enter the code during registration. If you lose it, write to us and we'll send a new one.

invoice.issued: We have sent tax invoice no. {number} in a separate e-mail.
invoice.pending: We will e-mail you the tax invoice in a moment.

credits.subject: Credited: {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}
credits.body: we have credited {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} to your account. You can carry on generating right away — nothing else to do.
credits.validity: The credits are valid until the end of the current credit period, just like the ones from your plan.

service.subject: Paid — pick a time for your brand setup
service.body: thank you for your payment. One thing left: pick a time.
service.detail: The session takes 30 minutes and runs online — you get the video call link with the confirmation. Before we meet we go through your brand and bring a finished proposal, so there is nothing to prepare.

plan.subjectNew: Payment confirmation — the {plan} plan is active
plan.received: we have received your payment of {amount}{label}.
plan.renewed: Your {plan} subscription has been renewed for another period.
plan.activated: The {plan} plan is active — post generation is unlocked.
